route_A_calibration_v0_3.doctrine: Route A threshold is the 95th percentile of pooled-HC Mahalanobis distance, NOT a fixed value. Calibrated per-version against the actual HC distance distribution under the hull.

phase_planning.phases_doctrine: There is no fixed N phases. Each phase expands HC representation along one dimension at a time (population / age span / sex / platform). The hull keeps versioning as long as new HC cohorts come in. Production deploys whatever the latest validated version is. At patient runtime, the chain queries the frozen current hull — no rebuild per patient.
